response.evidence: The ratio of the sizes of the two images is the ratio of the magnifications m1/m2. Since m1 = I1/O and m2 = I2/O, the ratio of sizes is m1/m2. Using the displacement method, m1 = (D+d)/(D-d) and m2 = (D-d)/(D+d), so the ratio is ((D+d)/(D-d))^2. With D=150 and d=90, the ratio is (240/60)^2 = 16. Both blind solves confirm the calculation steps, though one solver made an error in the final ratio calculation.
